title: Michelle Yeoh charms Filipino fans, champions Asian representation

blocks.text: If inclusivity is a person, Academy Award-winning actress Michelle Yeoh fits the description as she brought warmth to a room filled with Filipino fans the moment she arrived at the special screening of her upcoming series “Blade Runner 2099” in Manila on Monday, Nov. 23. Yeoh took time to sign autographs and pose for selfies with fans and members of the media even if she was told by her staff that autographs and selfies were not allowed — a gesture that later resonated with her remarks during the question-and-answer session about the importance of Asian inclusion in international productions.
